rawContent: We support the families of #GeorgeFloyd and those killed before him, and the organisations working to address racism in the #US, who are driving the #UN to call for action to stop the killings #BlackLivesMatter

We join our voices with theirs to call on the #UN Human Rights Council #HRC44 to convene a special session to address racist policing and the repression of protest in the #USA  #GeorgeFloyd #BreonnaTaylor #AhmaudArbery #BlackLivesMatter
